answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 8025 Country: India Title: I have a question in regards to Tabligh Jamaat. I was quite an active participant in work of tabligh 10 years back, but unfortunately I fell into the trap of duniya and has been almost inactive, although I seriously want to start again, but over last few years I have started getting many doubts and thoughts regarding the work. Another question is, Is there a curse regarding the one who has worked in tabligh (daawah) and then left the work and that person he will always be in distress. I heard it in some bayaan. Kindly clarify. Question: Assalam-o-alaikum. I have a question in regards to Tabligh Jamaat. I was quite an active participant in work of tabligh 10 years back, but unfortunately I fell into the trap of duniya and has been almost inactive, although I seriously want to start again, but over last few years I have started getting many doubts and thoughts regarding the work. Another question is, Is there a curse regarding the one who has worked in tabligh (daawah) and then left the work and that person he will always be in distress. I heard it in some bayaan. Kindly clarify. Assalam-o-alaikum Answer ID: 8025 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1823/1549=B/1429) (1) You must go in Jamat, in-sha-Allah the doubts shall go away. (2) There is no such thing. Do not get involved in doubts and confusion. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
